verdict.rationale: Cline is operated mainly through natural language. It builds features "through natural conversation" in the editor. The CLI takes plain-English prompts such as `cline "run tests and fix failures"` and `git diff | cline "review these changes"`, and it can be chatted with from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear. Community reports corroborate the conversational plan-then-execute workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically about how reliably natural-language commands are interpreted across surfaces such as the chat integrations.
